'''Rogue One draft''' is a custom 128-card ''Star Wars'' CCG set published by [[Owen Strombeck]].<ref name="ro" /> It is a self-contained cube for draft and sealed play: 64 Light Side cards and 64 Dark Side cards, using Jedha and Scarif from the film ''Rogue One''.<ref name="ro" />

Strombeck designed the set so every mechanic in the game text can be played with cards from this set only.<ref name="ro" /> He modeled the event structure on [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]: each player receives a 16-card fixed pack plus four 11-card expansion packs.<ref name="ro" />

Version 5.0 is dated 20 August 2024. Version 6.0 is dated 9 April 2026.<ref name="ro" />

== Composition ==
Each side has 16 fixed cards (two of those titles also appear as Uncommon and two as Common), 8 Rare, 16 Uncommon, and 28 Common.<ref name="ro" /> An eight-player cube uses four Dark Side fixed packs, four Light Side fixed packs, sixteen Dark expansion packs, and sixteen Light expansion packs.<ref name="ro" /> Each expansion pack is 1 Rare, 3 Uncommon, and 7 Common.<ref name="ro" />

== Downloads ==
Strombeck hosts a rules supplement PDF, a draft facilitation guide, printable pack wrappers, and 600&nbsp;dpi card images on the set page.<ref name="ro" /><ref name="supp" />
